title: rhopalocarpus alternifolius
intro: Rhopalocarpus alternifolius, commonly known as the "Horned Leaved Tree" or "Korom", is a plant species found in tropical regions of Asia. Rhopalocarpus alternifolius is known for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which work together to provide the plant's therapeutic benefits.
